title: Timepiece
description: Clocks that tell the time within Minecraft.
body:
A selection of clocks that tell the time within Minecraft.

Clocks include:

- Alarm clocks that ring at 7am in the morning. A classic red one and a retro one.
- A grandfather clock that chimes every hour.
- A mantle clock that ticks.
- A wall clock that ticks.
- A town hall clock that you can build around. It also includes a couple of gilt decorations. It chimes at 12 noon.
- A sundial.  Place it facing North. It only works when the sun is up!
- A Kit Cat Clock, the tail and eyes are animated.
- A couple of wristwatches. Leave them in your inventory and they will update every in-game hour. You can hold them to view them in hand. They can also be placed. Handy for travel!
- A Creeper clock that hisses!
- There's also a couple of finials and weathervanes to place on roof blocks - one in the center and one at the back. Place weathervanes facing North.
